zero_write_audit.summary: Pre/post zero-write HealthKit/Strength/policy audits byte-identical across both the Server deploy attempt and the successful deploy. This forensic reconciliation task performed only bounded read-only production reads (including two one-off, narrowly-scoped, non-committed diagnostic scripts run once each under the same safety contract) and zero writes.

decisions_required: Whether to authorize the Native presentation fix for Sep23 Activity History/Detail cache-key consistency (own build/TestFlight cycle).

Whether to authorize the Server presentation-layer fix for the Sep24 94-minute Strength duration defect, and separately whether to authorize a bounded correction of the one already-frozen Sep24 Logger evidence package's synthetic timing.

Cardio graduation: four separate, sequential authorization gates (deactivate workout policy; reactivate with families:[cardio,strength]; bounded reconciliation of the two specific already-deferred Sep24 Indoor Walk observations; and, as a separate later decision, wiring Cardio into Activity-total derivation/presentation, which is currently dead/unwired code).
Founder-device gate: verify Build 58's real-device current-day acceptance continues to hold under ordinary use.

September 23 Activity repair: NOT required per this audit's findings (canonical day already self-healed to revision 51/complete_day) -- no dry-run/apply authorization needed unless new evidence contradicts this.
unexpected_findings: The reviewed-and-approved Server candidate 07ed8230be28c2bc4989e2167b028d0bf425c6fa failed a real production webpack build (duplicate readBuildIdentity import) that node --check and the prior review method did not catch; corrected as f8c28700ae32c3a01b1859a988df5f8177a3dd0b with a new regression test for this exact failure class.

September 23 Activity's canonical day self-healed to revision 51/complete_day via ordinary automatic sync with no repair applied, while the Activity Day Detail screen kept showing a stale revision-50 snapshot due to a Native client-side cache-key collision/asymmetry -- a presentation bug, not a database problem.

The Sep24 Strength Logger session's frozen 94-minute duration is a known, code-acknowledged fallback mechanism (server-side commit-instant substituted for a missing Native finishedAt) that 'cannot move on reconciliation replay' even after the real, correct HealthKit workout later arrives.

Both Sep24 Indoor Walk observations reached the Server successfully and are correctly deferred (family_not_in_activation_scope, not lost/errored) under the current Strength-only workout policy; once deferred, an observation identity is never automatically reconsidered even after policy widens -- a new bounded reconciliation runner would need to be built.

The Cardio Activity-total derivation model (composeDailyActiveEnergyWithWorkouts) already exists and is correct but is unwired dead code -- canonicalizing Cardio workouts today would not change any number or add any visible surface in the shipped app without additional, separately-authorized engineering.

Cardio graduation: deactivate -> reactivate workout policy with families:[cardio,strength] (two separate authorizations, executed back-to-back with no gap, per the identified legacy-matcher transitional risk) -> bounded reconciliation of the two named Sep24 deferred Indoor Walk observations -> (separate decision) wire Activity-total derivation and a presentation surface for Cardio.
